newsitem.title: USA: AM Best reviews Superior National rating.
newsitem.headline: AM Best reviews Superior National rating.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said on Monday it has placed the "B+" (very good) rating of Superior National Insurance Co under review with negative implications.

A.M. Best, an insurance rating firm, said Superior National's move to renew and administer a significant amount of workers' compensation insurance currently written by Golden Eagle Insurance Co. Golden Eagle's operations were taken over by the state of California.
"The rating action reflects the uncertainty surrounding Superior's ability to adequately support the substantial new business volume expected from the Golden Eagle transaction," A.M. Best said.
Superior National said in a separate statement that A.M. Best will modify its views after the rating firm visits Superior National and examines the deal more closely.
